findings.closure_conditions: Ensure trailers are placed in a contiguous terminal block (separated from the commit message body by a blank line, with no empty lines between trailers) so that `git interpret-trailers --parse` / `agent-bus prepare-merge` parses `Agent-Bus-Agent: c-stdlib`.
findings.rationale: Commit dfdd67fb5620a0d627b3ea596ea41722ac7ccf8c has an intervening blank line between 'Agent-Bus-Agent: c-stdlib' and 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. Under git trailer conventions (and `git interpret-trailers --parse`), trailers must be in a single contiguous block at the end of the commit message. The blank line causes git to treat 'Agent-Bus-Agent' as commit body text rather than a trailer, leading `agent-bus prepare-merge` to fail with 'error: commit dfdd67fb5620a0d627b3ea596ea41722ac7ccf8c has no Agent-Bus-Agent trailer' under AGENT_REVIEW.md §1.2/§2.
